⭐ Welcome to Hmong Village Life Roleplay!!

👪Roleplay your village life! Tend your farm, grow and take care of your family! Meet new friends! 
Warning! If you have an older mobile/tablet device, you might not be able to load into the game. It is recommended that you use a newer device or laptop to play! 
🩸Beware! The game has some scary events such as our Blood Moon event, which has a 1% spawnrate chance. There is a ghost monster that will roam the map! Make sure you stay safe and indoors.

Thank you everyone for playing our game! 
Enjoy your time in HMONG LIFE RP! Please be nice to everyone.
